# Success metric

**Which number tells us a post worked?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C24


## Hook rate and skip rate first
<a id="hook-rate"></a>

Did people stay past the first seconds? The opening is judged above everything.

**Looks like:** Two reels with the same body but different openers; the one with the lower skip rate wins, and its hook style is reused.

**Good at:** fast feedback on hooks; organic reach; easy to read in Insights

**Weak at:** ignores conversion; for ads it 'doesn't really matter' if ROAS hits

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches all · goals retention, reach · effort low

**How:** Instagram Insights skip rate and 3-second views. Trial Reels to test openers.

**Backed by:** [Context in the first words, three channels](../topics/hooks.md#hook-context-first-words), [Per-post vs account metrics](../topics/growth.md#growth-post-and-account-metrics), [Trial Reels test hooks on non-followers](../topics/growth.md#growth-trial-reels), [Open loops, re-open one at ~15 s](../topics/story.md#story-open-loops), [Something new on screen every 1.2–2.5 s](../topics/editing.md#edit-change-every-1-5-2-5s) · sources L01, L07, SP

## Multiple of your own baseline
<a id="multiplier"></a>

Score each post against the median of your last 75–90 days, per format.

**Looks like:** A sheet: this reel is 1.8×, that one 0.6×. 'Viral for you' is about 4–5×. The monthly top 10% is studied for what they share.

**Good at:** fair comparison; learning from winners; calm about raw numbers

**Weak at:** needs history; a sheet to maintain

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, carousel, yt-short, yt-long · niches all · goals reach, retention · effort medium

**How:** Log the numbers about 11 days after posting. Update the benchmark monthly.

**Backed by:** [Multiplier sheet: score posts vs median](../topics/growth.md#growth-multiplier-sheet), [Viral For You = 4–5× your baseline](../topics/growth.md#growth-viral-for-you), [Monthly top-10% review](../topics/growth.md#growth-top-10-percent-review), [Pillar system: 3–5 formats × 3–4 a month](../topics/growth.md#growth-pillar-system), [Length: 7–15 s vibe, 20–60 s value](../topics/editing.md#edit-length-by-type) · sources L05, L08

## Sends and saves (one goal per video)
<a id="sends-saves"></a>

Decide before posting whether the reel is for sends, saves or comments, and judge it on that.

**Looks like:** A relatable reel is judged on sends per reach; a tutorial on saves. Likes are ignored.

**Good at:** matches ranking signals; clear intent per video; ignores vanity likes

**Weak at:** sends and saves show only in Insights; one goal can hide others

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, carousel · niches all · goals shares, saves, comments · effort low

**How:** Write the goal in the edit blueprint and check Insights after 24–72 h.

**Backed by:** [Pick one goal: comments, sends or saves](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-conversation-goal), [Reels signals: watch time, sends, saves](../topics/growth.md#growth-ranking-signals), [Shareability: why would they send it?](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-shareability-test), [Waterfall and repurpose winners](../topics/growth.md#growth-waterfall), [Comment KEYWORD and I'll send it](../topics/growth.md#growth-comment-keyword-cta) · sources L08, L07, SP

## Conversions: leads, sales, ROAS
<a id="conversion"></a>

Only metrics that change actions: sign-ups, sales, return on ad spend.

**Looks like:** A reel with fewer views but 40 email sign-ups beats a viral one with none. Ads are judged on ROAS, not thumb stop.

**Good at:** business results; ignores vanity numbers; shows what pays

**Weak at:** needs a funnel to measure; slow to show early

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-long, story · niches all · goals sales · effort medium

**How:** UTM links or keyword counts per reel; ad maths in Meta Ads Manager.

**Backed by:** [Ad maths and the Meta test](../topics/business.md#biz-ad-maths), [Track only metrics that change actions](../topics/growth.md#growth-track-few-metrics), [Per-post vs account metrics](../topics/growth.md#growth-post-and-account-metrics), [Follow up with "not now" people](../topics/business.md#biz-follow-up-not-now), [Weekly lead magnet into an owned list](../topics/growth.md#growth-lead-magnet-series) · sources L07, L05

## Untangle: one variable at a time
<a id="untangle"></a>

Split each video into hook, format, topic and illustration, and change one per week.

**Looks like:** Same topic and format, new hook style this week; next week same hook, new format. The cause of a win becomes visible.

**Good at:** learning what works; fewer false lessons; works with small numbers

**Weak at:** slow; needs discipline

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches all · goals retention, reach · effort medium

**How:** Tag each post's four parts in a sheet.

**Backed by:** [Untangle: hook, format, topic, illustration](../topics/growth.md#growth-untangle-data), [70 / 20 / 10 proven, iterate, experiment](../topics/growth.md#growth-70-20-10), [Teaching format: template card, then a real example](../topics/editing.md#l11-template-then-example), [Desire hook: this is exactly what you want to see](../topics/hooks.md#l11-desire-hook), [Hook template bank (fill in the blanks)](../topics/hooks.md#l11-hook-template-bank) · sources L08, L05

## Mixing
The multiplier sheet can carry any of these columns. Hook rate for organic and conversions for ads is how Oren splits it.

## Rule of thumb
Testing openers: hook rate. Fair trend reading: multiplier. Ranking signals: sends and saves. Business: conversion. Learning why: untangle.
